spec.name: Orange Pets cowboy hat
spec.description: Warm brown miniature cowboy hat with a wide square brim, stepped raised sides, a low recessed crown and a dark leather band. Centered for forehead attachment with a flat underside and no straps.

prompt: A warm brown cowboy hat with a wide square brim, stepped raised sides and a low indented crown, dark brown leather band. Original hat only, no animal/head/stand/background/text. For tiny vanilla Minecraft pets: 4-18 purposeful unrotated axis-aligned cuboids. Geometry within x=2..14,z=2..14,y=0..14, centre x=z=8, flat underside at y=0, front negative Z. One compact painted cube-net texture atlas, pixel art at one texel per unit. Explicit integer uvSize for fractional details. Connected pieces without z-fighting. No bones or animations. Uniformly scaled to an animal forehead with no straps or parts below y=0.
